verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents its own REST API (deployments, assistant, analytics), but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for it, and probes of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Its OpenAPI support is about rendering customers' specs into docs, and the llms.txt endpoint summaries are prose, not a machine-readable API spec.
